intro: This unit covers essential translation skills for the TNPSC Group 2/2A Prelims exam, focusing on converting words and sentences between English and Tamil while accurately handling tenses and voices.

sections.heading: Word Translation
points: Focus on translating single words accurately, paying close attention to context and synonyms.
Understand the nuances of Tamil vocabulary to avoid literal or incorrect translations.
Practice common TNPSC-specific vocabulary words frequently asked in past exams.

sections.heading: Sentence Translation
points: Maintain the original sentence structure and meaning while translating between English and Tamil.
Ensure grammatical correctness and proper syntax in the translated sentence.
Pay attention to idiomatic expressions and translate them contextually rather than word-for-word.

sections.heading: Tense Related Translation
points: Identify the correct tense (past, present, future) in the source sentence before translating.
Ensure the translated sentence in Tamil accurately reflects the time frame of the original English sentence.
Watch out for continuous, perfect, and passive tenses during the translation process.

sections.heading: Tense/Voice Related Tasks
points: Recognize the voice of the sentence, whether it is active or passive, before translating.
Convert the voice appropriately while keeping the core meaning intact in the target language.
Practice translating complex sentences involving mixed tenses and active-passive structures.

exam_tips: Always read the entire sentence carefully to understand the context before starting the translation.
In tense-related tasks, double-check that the translated Tamil sentence matches the exact time frame of the original English sentence.
Practice previous years' question papers to get familiar with the specific style and difficulty of the translation section.
title: Unit VI: Translation
